Only value above face (about $20 for 40) would come from a 1966 round silver 50c hiding under others (such lots sold A$410 for 11 on 20 Sep 2026, item 377507290940, and A$530.70 for 17 on 7 Nov 2026, item 137893646794). None visible in the photo, so treat as face value plus a little. || TERAPEAK RE-CHECK (9 Nov 2026): Circulated commemorative 50c coins sell singly for about A$2.75-3.75 each with hundreds sold, so 40-45 coins is about A$110-160 only if each is listed one by one (not worth the effort), and bulk lots sell for less. Face value is about A$20-23, which is the floor.
